THE PROTEUS COACHING & DEVELOPMENT PIPELINE

ONE CONNECTED
PATHWAY.

From early sporting fundamentals to advanced coaching, performance environments and industry development, Proteus supports participants, coaches and organisations at every stage of the sporting journey.

  1. 01

    Early Foundations & Fundamentals

    Movement skills and a positive first experience of sport in preschools and Montessori centres.

    Early Years & Fundamentals
  2. 02

    Primary School Activation

    Before, during and after-school programmes that get every child involved.

    School Sports & Coaching Holiday Programmes
  3. 03

    Community & School Sport

    Consistent club and secondary school coaching that strengthens sporting structures.

    School Sports & Coaching Community Organisation
  4. 04

    Advanced Coaching & Performance

    Academy, regional and high-performance coaching, plus specialised 1:1 and small-group work.

    2027 Athlete Academy Individual & Performance Coaching
  5. 05

    Network & Industry Development

    Coach and player education, networking, travel and events that grow the sporting network.

    Coach Development
  6. 06

    Organisational & Community Support

    Governance, recruitment and marketing support, plus teacher aid and elderly care programmes.

    Teacher Aid Active Age Programme Community Organisation

People first. Development always. We combine people, systems, partnerships and industry knowledge to deliver programmes that are accessible, sustainable and impactful.
